impact_assessment.benefits: Players can see who wants what and how exposed their new relics are without opening another screen.

[1/2] Cape becomes a fifth worn slot with four capes and a separate cyan-band recolour so it changes the cloak on the actor and the doll without touching the robe; the relic panel grows from min(60vh,460px) to min(74vh,600px) and the doll to a three-row grid. The quest screen becomes an RPG journal with counts, five filter tabs, portraits, progress bars and the daily mark. Maze merchants open a five-line stall (healing, mana, bombs, traps, relic) with section-scaled prices and one sale per line. Mana flasks are drinkable with R, drop from kills/urns/crystals/chests, are sold by merchants and saved. Leveling is steeper (42*1.6, 0.3 kill XP). Level cards ignore the swing click, double-clicks and stationary pointers via a 550ms/8px/1.5s guard. Failing-first tests: inventory-cape, ui-choice-guard, merchant-shop, mana-potion, ui-quest-log, plus updates to balance, systems and input fuzz fixtures.

impact_assessment.why: Player request for capes, a taller bag, an RPG quest UI, maze consumable vendors, harder leveling, safe level-up clicks and mana potions.
impact_assessment.benefits: Five gear choices with visible cloak colour, a journal that reads like an RPG, a reason to spend shards in the maze, a second consumable resource, and no lost levels from attack spam.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: EquipmentSlot gains cape, InputFrame gains manaPotion, SimEvent gains shop/manaPotion, Player gains manaPotions and RunState saves it; dependency: cloak hue band 175-202 must not overlap the robe band 205-255; concurrency: none; state: old saves lack cape and manaPotions; balance: level 5 now costs 275 and kills pay 30%.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Defaults for old saves, hue-band separation tested through gearLooks and sprite palettes, pure guard/shop/bank tests, browser checks at 1280x720, 768x1024 and 390x844, and an ADR naming the intentional test updates.

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Verified: 25 relic boxes (5 worn + 20 bag), cape box and recoloured doll sheet at 1280x720/768x1024/390x844 with no horizontal overflow; the quest journal filtered four sections behind five tabs with portrait cards and progress bars; a maze stall sold five lines once each (mana draught 500->470 shards, flasks 1->2, Sold); R restored 60/60 mana and spent a flask; a forced level card ignored a 17ms click but accepted one after 1.6s (vitality); 896 tests across 190 files, 476 mechanics, lint/typecheck/build clean, 8/8 gates; four browser screenshots recorded.
Task 'cape-quest-shop-mana' completed successfully.

impact_assessment.risks: contract: none (no saved shape changes); dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: extra interactable per floor changes generation determinism for existing seeds.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Deterministic placement, 24-seed availability coverage, focused shop-line tests and a browser check on a fresh server; the map is refreshed after the change.

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Content expansion: six new enemy records (Bone Picker, Lantern Wraith, Cinder Stalker, Spire Marksman, Reliquary Warden, Salt Orchard Hydra) using tinted borrowed sheets with boss-scale frames and patterns; two new late sections, The Gilded Reliquary (section 22) and The Salt Orchard (section 23), pushing the Keeper to 24 and the First Memory finale to 25; new mobs added to four existing rosters. Quest expansion: a second chapter for every resident (12 quests), chapter-aware selection, an epilogue per chapter, late story lines, and a persisted tracked-quest with a HUD tracker. Tests: content-expansion and quest-chapters plus intentional updates to section-count, checkpoint, depth-clamp and quest-reference assertions (ADR-226).

impact_assessment.why: Player request for new enemies, new sections, a better quest log, and better quests and story.
impact_assessment.benefits: Two more late road stops with new guardians and mobs, discoverable late enemies across four existing biomes, six new quest chapters with closing story beats, and a pinned quest line that follows the run.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: FINAL_DEPTH moves 22 to 24, Meta gains trackedQuest, quest selection becomes chapter-aware; dependency: borrowed sheets must exist in the atlas for every new enemy; concurrency: none; state: old saves at depth 22 now load The Salt Orchard, and old meta defaults trackedQuest null.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Plans are depth-sequential and covered by a new expansion test, atlas ids are reused keys, defaults cover old saves, and the migration change is named in ADR-226.

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Verified: 6 new enemies exist with tinted sheet mappings and boss-sized frames; plans are depth-sequential 0-24 with The Gilded Reliquary at 21, The Salt Orchard at 22, keeper at 23 and first_memory at 24; new mobs appear in four existing rosters; 12 quests give every resident two chapters with epilogues and late stories; trackedQuest saves, persists and hides after claim. 918 tests across 194 files, 478 mechanics, lint/typecheck/build clean, 8/8 gates.
